سللتن (form I)
# سَلَلْتُنَّ (salaltunna) /sa.lal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of سَلَّ (salla)
# سُلِلْتُنَّ (suliltunna) /su.lil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
